hero.desc: Pharmatrack helps you quickly find nearby pharmacies where your prescribed medicine is available. Save time, avoid unnecessary travel, and get the medicine you need faster.

why.title: WHY PHARMATRACK
why.subtitle: Built for patients and pharmacies  communities
why.card1_desc: See which pharmacy have the medicine in the stock.
why.card2_desc: Find pharmacy near you with distance and direction.
why.card3_desc: Avoid unnecessary travel and get what you need faster.

how.title: How It Works
how.subtitle: Get medicine availability in just a few simple steps
how.step1_desc: Enter the name of the medicine you need.
how.step2_desc: Locate nearby pharmacies that have it in stock.
how.step4_desc: Go to the pharmacy and get your medicine.
